documents.results_announcement: Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) — the detailed results document

source_notes: Skeleton built 2026-09-01 with review round 9, when the manifest landed without a registry file. Holds only what the manifest work itself established: names, the 31 March financial calendar, and each doc_type's Macquarie name. The measures and walk-label maps are deliberately absent: Macquarie is the sealed exam bank, and distilling its disclosure language after the exam questions were authored risks steering the agent toward exam topics. Distil them from the documents alone after the exam concludes. No financial numbers in this file (ADR-0003).
